summary.text: Gena Puckett is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A retired public school teacher of 31 years, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running to support more funding for public education, protect rural healthcare, and stand with working families.

paragraphs.text: Gena Puckett earned bachelor's degrees from Missouri Western State University and Northwest Missouri State University, and her career included work as a teacher.
In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign described her as a retired public school teacher, mother and grandmother who has spent her life in Northwest Missouri.

The survey said she decided to run after learning that Missouri ranked in the bottom 10 for education, and listed the AFL-CIO and the Missouri Federation of Women's Democratic Clubs among her endorsers.
